author: N6rL
content:
Complete. rusqlite 0.38.0 (bundled) added to Cargo.toml. New module alcanzai-core/src/sqlite_library.rs: SqliteLibrary struct, open()/open_in_memory() constructors, configure_conn (WAL + FK + NORMAL sync pragmas), run_migrations (schema_meta version table + MIGRATIONS slice applied in transactions). LibraryError::Database(#[from] rusqlite::Error) added to error.rs. lib.rs updated with pub mod + pub use.

Schema (v1): knowledge_objects, dedup_anchors_index (UNIQUE object_id, uidx_dedup_hash, uidx_dedup_doi, uidx_dedup_arxiv), citation_edges (dangling-target support), relationships.

9 new unit tests pass: all tables present, schema_version=1, 3 UNIQUE constraints enforced, NULL doi coexistence, migration idempotency. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test all clean (20 total tests).

#15 (Library::resolve_identity + Library::ingest) is now unblocked.
